37a8c92e6a02e5b7.desc: Skillet tap into the sound of surviving any adversity, dusting yourself off, and getting back up again for another round. Heavy guitars kick with the inspiration to keep going, while stadium-size hooks double as a reminder to never give up no matter what. The quartet—John Cooper [lead vocals, bass], Korey Cooper [guitar, keys, production], Jen Ledger [drums, vocals], and Seth Morrison [lead guitar]—have quietly, yet indisputably become one of the biggest global hard rock bands of the 21st century with total album sales just shy of 22 million, an average of 12 million monthly Spotify listeners, and dozens of massive placements across sports, film, and television. Among a catalog highlighted by chart-topping albums and hits, the 6x-Platinum “Monster” has eclipsed 5 billion global streams, claimed a place in Spotify’s “Billions Club,” and resounded as “one of the most-streamed rock songs of all time.” During 2025, their first-ever Christmas release “O Come, O Come Emmanuel” made a viral impact and captured #1 on five Billboard charts. 3734ccfea672ef21.title: So Cal Bike Expo
3734ccfea672ef21.desc: Three days. Two wheels. One epic outdoor expo. Set in Santa Clarita’s Central Park on Halloween weekend. 9 acres of beautiful green floor space with amazing 80 degree fall weather. Southern California is the Heart of Cycling Culture. With the opening of one of the largest public bike parks in the world and some of the region’s best cycling infrastructure, Santa Clarita is uniquely positioned to host a destination-level bicycle expo, complete with city nightlife, music, food and beverages – all within an hour of three major airports. Attendees will experience brand interactions, bike demos, group rides, a vintage bike show, evening events throughout the city, and nonstop on-bike energy from morning to night.
